title: FD-7749 IGV reference genome signing MRE
description: Generates a synthetic custom reference genome and IGV JSON configs that point at it

main_options.title: Main options
main_options.description: Where to publish the genome and IGV config fixtures

outdir.description: Output directory for the reference genome and IGV configs
outdir.help_text: Must be an absolute cloud path such as gs://my-bucket/pr3-mre. This value is written into the generated IGV config files as the reference genome's fastaURL and indexURL, so a relative path produces configs pointing at nothing. The bucket needs a Data Link and a CORS policy exposing Range.
